description: Five EU countries, including Germany and Denmark, are planning to set up a migrant deportation centre in Rwanda. This centre will specifically handle rejected asylum seekers who have exhausted all legal options to remain in Europe. The countries aim to make this facility operational by 2027 and will initially accommodate around 100 migrants. The proposed arrangement reflects a broader shift in the EU’s immigration policy and deportation strategies.
title: Europe's migrant crackdown: Rejected asylum seekers face deportation to Rwanda

author: HIJAM RAJU SINGH
description: In a unanimous decision, Jay Shah has been reappointed as ICC Chair for a second term at the helm of world cricket. His new tenure will coincide with cricket's return to the Olympics at Los Angeles 2028. The BCCI hailed his contributions to the game, including the landmark launch of the Women's Premier League. Shah's second term comes at a crucial time as cricket looks to expand its footprint in emerging markets and reach wider audiences across the world.
title: Jay Shah reappointed as ICC Chair; BCCI hails leadership ahead of cricket's Oly return

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: In a captivating legal battle, three sisters successfully contested their brother's appraisal of their father's estate, uncovering hidden assets of substantial value. The ruling confirmed that their father's life savings and possessions in India are part of the estate. Judge Nicholas Parfitt mandated the brother to cover the sisters' legal expenses from his inheritance, stressing the importance of sibling collaboration in the estate's settlement.
title: 3 UK sisters win £1.6m estate fight; brother denied sole claim to gold in India

author: AASHISH VASHISTHA
title: Zohran Mamdani disbands NYPD unit accused of using excessive force against protesters

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: DHS has proposed a rule change that could affect the approval of visa extensions for foreign workers. The removal of deference to prior approvals may complicate extension applications, particularly for H-1B workers. As a result, this change could lead to more requests for evidence and longer processing times. Employers, especially small businesses, might face additional challenges with H-1B petitions.
title: US govt’s one sentence USCIS rule change that can impact H-1B visa extension forms

author: PRIYANKA JAISWAL
title: Lakshmi Venu challenges TVS family settlement, seeks partition of father's assets

author: PRANAV SHUKLA
description: In a candid critique, Kapil Dev has questioned Virat Kohli's decision to step away from Test cricket, asserting that Kohli was fit enough to continue his remarkable journey at the top level. He underscored the significance of tenacity in cricket, drawing inspiration from Mohinder Amarnath's enduring legacy. With over ten successful years in Test matches behind him, Kohli is shifting his focus to ODIs, ready to carve out new victories.
title: 'He will regret it after 10 years': Kapil Dev questions Virat Kohli's big decision

author: PATHIKRIT CHAKRABORTY
description: Mohammad Azam Khan has been remanded to judicial custody following a CBI court ruling after Enforcement Directorate custody. His arrest relates to a money laundering case involving Mohammad Ali Jauhar University in Rampur. The investigation centers on alleged financial irregularities involving public funds and land grabbing. Additional allegations include diversion of funds connected to multiple FIRs registered against him.
title: Azam Khan sent to 14-day judicial custody after ED questioning in Jauhar University case

author: AASTHA JHA
title: 'Huge spending, no improvement': SC raps administration over Yamuna pollution

author: TRISHA MAHAJAN
description: During a significant bust unveiling event, Amit Shah shared heartfelt condolences on the untimely passing of Ajit Pawar. He acknowledged Pawar’s impactful contributions, especially during the challenging Covid-19 pandemic, contrasting his proactive approach with prior government communication challenges. Meanwhile, Maharashtra’s Chief Minister, Devendra Fadnavis, urgently called for the swift release of the investigation report into the tragic plane crash that took Ajit Pawar's life on January 28.
title: 'When CM was unavailable, Ajit Pawar was there': Amit Shah remembers ex-Maha deputy CM

author: HIJAM RAJU SINGH
description: Litton Das celebrated his daughter's birthday by scoring a century against South Africa in a Test match. He dedicated his eighth Test hundred to her with a heartfelt message. After a tough start for Bangladesh, Das and Towhid Hridoy formed a significant partnership to recover the innings. Das eventually scored 120 runs, contributing to Bangladesh's total of 400. South Africa faced early challenges in their reply, losing a wicket quickly.
title: 'This 100 is for you!': Litton Das dedicates century to daughter on her birthday

author: PRIYANKA JAISWAL
title: Ajit Pawar plane crash: Maha CM urges Shah to fast-track probe, release early report

author: TOI WORLD DESK
title: California mansion where five people were murdered in 1970 lists for $4.6 million

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: At just 19, Sumair Kandhari is helping bridge the digital divide in rural Bihar through Pathways Plus, a digital education initiative launched in 2023. After raising $10,000, he established a computer laboratory in Samastipur and developed a programme teaching children computer skills, Python, artificial intelligence and digital literacy. By training 27 local instructors, he has helped make technology education more accessible and sustainable. Recognised in the Diana Award's 2026 Roll of Honour, his initiative has reached over 1,700 students and 750 women, opening doors to new opportunities.
title: Bihar digital skills drive reaches 1,700 students, 750 women; trains 27 tutors

author: TOI BUSINESS DESK
description: Delhi Metro’s driverless trains carried a staggering 1.6 million passengers in a single day on November 2 this year, as commuters travelled in large numbers ahead of Diwali. The driverless trains operate through a fully automated system, removing the possibility of human error. Following the introduction of driverless services on the Magenta Line, the Delhi Metro’s Pink Line adopted these trains as well.
title: Delhi Metro driverless trains carry millions everyday; should other networks follow?

author: PRANAV SHUKLA
description: Dale Steyn recounted his early impression of Virat Kohli from the 2008 Under-19 World Cup, describing him initially as a brash young talent. However, playing together at RCB transformed Steyn’s view. Their mutual appreciation for food and music fostered a strong friendship off the pitch. Steyn acknowledged Kohli's raw talent but felt he required mentorship as he navigated the complexities of a budding cricket career.
title: 'Who is this cocky little guy?': Dale Steyn's first impression of Virat Kohli

author: AASTHA JHA
title: 17 dead as 2 mass shootings rock South Africa within 24 hours

author: SAURABH THAKUR
description: A consumer commission in Telangana directed SBI General Insurance to pay Rs 18 lakh to a deceased man's family. The claim was initially rejected due to the absence of a driving licence, but the family contested this decision. The family alleged that the insurance policy did not require a driving licence clause for coverage. After discussions, both parties agreed on a settlement amount of Rs 18 lakh.
title: Insurer rejected claim over driving licence; family gets Rs 18 lakh in settlement

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Richard Knapp, a US Air Force veteran, faced felony theft charges after retrieving his combat helmet. He was arrested at Washington Dulles International Airport while traveling with family and held for 11 days. Authorities dropped the charges after witness statements corroborated his ownership of the helmet. Knapp's health condition raised concerns during his detention without necessary medication.
title: US veteran jailed 11 days for taking back loaned Iraq helmet; theft case dropped

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: Elon Musk’s SpaceX has confirmed talks to buy about 1,200 acres of Texas public parkland around its Starbase rocket site, with 600 acres to be protected as coastal habitat under a permanent conservation easement. Boca Chica Beach is excluded from the proposal. The deal faces pushback from environmental groups, and Governor-elect Gina Hinojosa has asked Texas Parks and Wildlife to take no action during her transition.
title: Why SpaceX wants 1,200 acres of Texas parkland near Starbase, but not Boca Chica Beach

author: ARYAN SINGH
description: In response to Akhilesh Yadav's recent appeal to the Dalit community, BJP leaders have launched a series of critiques against the Samajwadi Party chief. They pointed out the SP's past failures regarding Dalit issues during its tenure, with Uttar Pradesh MSME minister Bhupendra Singh Chaudhary highlighting various incidents of Dalit oppression.
title: 'Dalit oppression, land grab': BJP hits back at Akhilesh over 'Damdar Dalit' remarks

author: RAJ SHEKHAR JHA
description: Gangster Goldy Dhillon has issued a death threat against Bollywood actors Amitabh and Abhishek Bachchan. This threat comes after unsubstantiated remarks made by Amitabh regarding the 1984 riots. Dhillon claimed that the recent arrest of his associates would not deter their operations in Mumbai. He stated that anyone opposing the Sikh community would be considered an enemy of his group.
title: 'Bulletproof cabins won't save them': Gangster Goldy targets Amitabh, Abhishek Bachchan

author: AASTHA JHA
description: India has taken a significant step by joining a US-led initiative alongside nine other nations to secure their artificial intelligence supply chains. This coalition is designed to protect sensitive technologies while countering competition from China. By creating working groups focused on cooperation in AI policy and security, these countries aim to fortify their economic and national security, building on last year's Pax Silica program that addresses critical resource safeguarding.
title: India joins US-led alliance to secure AI supply chains amid China tech rivalry

author: SHREEDHAR RATHI
description: A consumer commission in Malappuram directed Samsung to pay Rs 20,000 for an unusable AC due to spare part unavailability. The customer, Sakeer V P, reported a cooling issue after six years of use and faced further issues with repairs. Samsung's service center demanded charges despite the AC not being repaired, which led to a complaint. The commission found Samsung and the service center responsible for the deficiency in service.
title: Kerala man wins Rs 35,500 after Samsung AC fails despite 10-year warranty claim

author: HAIMANTI MUKHERJEE
description: Every winter, millions shut their bedroom windows against the haze, hoping four walls will protect their rest. New studies from Delhi and around the world show that polluted air slips right indoors—quietly fragmenting deep sleep even when you never wake up coughing.
title: How air pollution is leaving us sleepless in an already-sleep-deprived world

author: PRIYANKA JAISWAL
title: UN backs ASEAN's Myanmar outreach, says 'violence needs to stop'

author: KSHITIZ
description: A heartbreaking event unfolded in Mohammadpur Birauli village during the Chhath festival, involving a four-year-old girl. It's reported that her mother, Reena Kumari, struck her for touching sacred offerings, resulting in the child's untimely death. Local authorities apprehended Reena, while the girl’s body has been sent for a post-mortem investigation. The father, Raju Paswan, is overwhelmed with sorrow and calls for his wife's severe punishment.
title: 4-year-old girl dies after mother beats her for touching Chhath prasad

author: TRISHA MAHAJAN
description: Helen Haines, the Australian lawmaker, was discharged from hospital after critical injuries from an incident last month. She expressed gratitude for the care received during her treatment and the ongoing support from people worldwide. The incident on October 19 left her with severe injuries, leading to the amputation of both legs. Contributions to Save the Children have exceeded 1.4 million Australian dollars as per her family's request.
title: Australian MP Helen Haines discharged a month after losing both legs in car attack

author: SHREEDHAR RATHI
description: Bengaluru Urban District Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission directed a credit co-operative society to refund Rs 1,12,304. The commission ruled that the society failed to repay the complete amount due after partial payments were made. The society acknowledged its liability but cited financial difficulties due to loan defaults by its members. Vanajakshi had deposited Rs 4 lakh in fixed accounts with the society and sought full repayment.
title: Bengaluru woman denied full FD refund, consumer court orders 12% interest

author: ARYAN SINGH
description: In a pivotal speech at the Lord Mayor's Banquet, British Prime Minister Andy Burnham will delve into the detrimental repercussions of Brexit. He will assert that the UK has encountered significant economic challenges following its exit from the EU. Burnham intends to outline three fundamental guidelines for future dealings with Brussels, advocating for improved outcomes for the public.
title: Brexit rethink? UK PM Burnham admits Britain lost more than it gained

author: AASTHA JHA
title: Nvidia scandal: Singapore, US discuss Megaspeed as firm's Indonesia unit faces scrutiny

author: MAJOR GENERAL RAJAN KOCHHAR RETD
description: Matthew Aaron VanDyke and six Ukrainians were arrested for allegedly training ethnic armed organisations in drone warfare. The investigation revealed potential links between the accused and insurgent groups in Myanmar and India. VanDyke was granted bail due to the incomplete chargesheet related to terrorism under the Unlawful Activities (Prevention) Act. Concerns about the transfer of military technology to non-state actors raise serious security implications.
title: Vandyke case: Foreign military trainers, drone warfare and security challenge

author: HIJAM RAJU SINGH
description: India has kicked off a stellar journey in the Olympic qualification cycle for shooting by securing three quota spots for the Los Angeles 2028 Olympics at the ISSF World Championship. With impressive performances across rifle, pistol, and shotgun events, the National Rifle Association of India has recognised the composure of our shooters.
title: Three LA 2028 quotas! India make best start to Olympic shooting cycle in decades

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: A 68-year-old man from Macomb County won $500,000 while playing the Michigan Lottery's 25 Days of Winning game. This large prize stemmed from a family Christmas tradition where lottery tickets were given as gifts. Initially believing he won only $500, a scan revealed the true amount of $500,000. The winning ticket was purchased at M & H Petro LLC in Clinton Township.
title: Michigan man mistakes $500,000 lottery win for $500; waits nearly a year

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Fifteen-year-old Khaira Ojima Bala has triumphed in the UBA Foundation National Essay Competition, outshining over 15,000 competitors from secondary schools nationwide. Her insightful essay tackled the themes of food security and national development, urging her peers to contemplate critical societal challenges. As a reward for her exceptional work, Bala is awarded a ₦15 million scholarship for her university education.
title: At 15, Nigerian girl wins 15m-naira grant for essay picked from 15,000 entries

author: TOI BUSINESS DESK
description: A Mumbai woman received Rs 50 lakh from a property developer under a redevelopment agreement. She then invested the amount in Rural Electrification Corporation (REC) bonds to claim income tax exemption. However, the Income Tax Department treated the receipt as “Income from Other Sources” instead of capital gains, and denied her the benefit of the exemption claimed under Section 54EC of the Income Tax Act, 1961.
title: She got Rs 50L for redevelopment; denied capital gains exemption. ITAT gives relief

author: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK
description: In a recent interview, Ramya Krishnan dispelled rumors surrounding her marriage to Krishna Vamsi, affirming their union despite geographical distances due to their careers. Their son, Rithwik, attends school in Chennai to manage the challenges posed by their busy schedules. Ramya openly described marriage as an overrated endeavor, highlighting their continued friendship and a harmonious relationship despite living apart.
title: Ramya Krishnan denies separation rumours with Krishna Vamsi

author: AASTHA JHA
description: Dolly Vadalia, originally from Mozambique, encountered significant obstacles in her quest for Indian citizenship due to a lack of documentation. After her marriage in 2023, multiple attempts to secure her passport were denied due to her parents' failure to register her birth. However, the Indian embassy stepped in to ensure her birth was recorded, and on November 11, she finally obtained her Indian passport.
title: Parents fled Africa with unregistered newborn; 26 yrs later, she gets Indian passport

author: JYOTIRMOY HALDER
description: Rajat Patidar smashed an unbeaten 135 off just 48 balls, including 13 sixes, to help Madhya Pradesh post 250/6 against Assam in the Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy. He set multiple state records with his explosive innings. The knock also comes as a major boost for Royal Challengers Bengaluru ahead of the IPL 2027 retention deadline.
title: Rajat Patidar scripts SMAT history, set new state record for most sixes

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Garage, an innovative marketplace created by Martin Hunt, specializes in used fire department equipment, connecting buyers to much-needed surplus emergency vehicles. Recently securing $41 million in Series B funding, Garage's valuation has skyrocketed as it now serves over 1,000 communities across the U.S. and Canada, with plans to expand into public works and sanitation equipment markets.
title: Ex-firefighter quits Goldman Sachs to sell used fire trucks; startup worth $225m

author: PRIYANKA JAISWAL
title: 'Who ordered SIR?' Cong seeks SC nod to pose 48 questions to EC over 'vote chori'

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: Canada remains committed to sustaining an integrated automotive market with the US while considering alternatives. Prime Minister Mark Carney emphasized the importance of utilizing Canada's skilled workforce and manufacturing capabilities. Discussions with Chinese President Xi Jinping include vehicle manufacturing and investment opportunities. Carney insisted that any future Chinese investment must include significant manufacturing facilities within Canada.
title: Carney warns US: Canada has ‘best auto workers,’ will move on without deal

author: AASTHA JHA
description: The Food Safety and Standards Authority of India has expressed alarm over the sugar classification of Red Bull, urging the brand to provide scientific proof for its energy drink label. They highlighted that the high sugar content could mislead consumers about safe intake levels. Red Bull has been given a seven-day deadline to respond, or it may face a ban.
title: Energy drink or sugar? FSSAI sends notice to Red Bull over composition of beverage

author: ARYAN SINGH
description: Retired US Navy Admiral Philip Davidson has voiced significant worries regarding Taiwan's ability to defend itself against potential Chinese aggression. He notes the strengthening of military partnerships in the region and Taiwan's determination to withstand an assault. Nevertheless, insufficient air defense systems might compromise Taiwan's deterrence. Davidson emphasizes the necessity to counteract China's disinformation strategies that seek to erode public trust.
title: US admiral revisits chilling 2027 China-Taiwan conflict prediction - what's changed?

author: YUDHVIR RANA
description: In a shocking incident, an SUV was hijacked at gunpoint from Downtown Mall 44 on the Pathankot-Jammu National Highway. The assailant brandished a firearm at the driver before making a swift escape. In response to this alarming crime, police have intensified surveillance measures near the Jammu and Himachal Pradesh borders to deter any potential terrorist actions.
title: Pathankot on high alert after SUV snatched at gunpoint near Jammu highway

author: SHIVANGHI PAYAL
description: Anthropic is planning an initial public offering that could value the company at $1.4 trillion. Recent tech IPOs have shown varied results, with some stocks gaining while others have lost value. The company reported rising revenue but also faced significant losses in its operations. Early investors will be able to sell shares immediately after the IPO, unlike standard lock-up provisions.
title: Anthropic is eyeing a mega IPO, but will investors buy its trillion-dollar AI dream?

author: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK
description: Ramayana is riding high at the box office, having raked in Rs 185 crore in its second weekend alone. Featuring a star-studded cast including Ranbir Kapoor, Yash, and Sai Pallavi, the film is closing in on a remarkable Rs 1,400 crore globally. Its India collection stands at Rs 763.63 crore nett, indicating solid audience interest in its eleventh day. A sequel is expected to launch during Diwali 2028, generating excitement.
title: Ramayana crosses Rs 760 crore on Day 12 after record second Sunday

author: YASHASVI VASISTHA
description: The United Nations is ready to engage in nuclear disarmament discussions between the United States, China, and Russia. UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres emphasized the need for cautious optimism regarding potential agreements. US President Donald Trump plans to raise arms reduction efforts during the upcoming meeting of world leaders. China perceives this trilateral meeting as vital for global peace and stability.
title: UN chief hopes Trump-Xi-Putin meeting will lead to nuclear disarmament efforts

author: TRISHA MAHAJAN
description: After the New York Jets' disappointing defeat against the Buffalo Bills, a fire erupted in an empty postgame tent outside MetLife Stadium. Fortunately, fire crews responded swiftly, ensuring the thick smoke did not escalate into a larger problem. Remarkably, there were no injuries or significant damage reported, and train services remained unaffected despite the chaos.
title: Watch: Fire outside MetLife Stadium sends smoke over field after Jets' 31-12 loss

author: YASHASVI VASISTHA
description: Indian oil refiners may see advantages from tighter global diesel supplies and ongoing refining margins. Falling diesel exports from China are expected to support Indian refining profitability. Domestic upstream producers like ONGC and Oil India face production challenges and government policy issues. European gas inventories are currently below seasonal averages, highlighting market tightness. The outlook for India's oil and gas sector varies significantly between refining and upstream production.
title: Indian refiners set to benefit as global diesel inventories hit fresh lows: Report

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Through her own experiences in technology, Pearl Oguchi uncovered the challenges Black women face in their careers, identifying a significant absence of support. In response, she created Black Women in Tech, a flourishing community that has grown to include more than 50,000 members. This platform provides essential resources such as job referrals and CV reviews while fostering mentorship.
title: After tech isolation, Pearl Oguchi builds 50,000-member network for Black women

author: TOI BUSINESS DESK
description: Bihar accounts for the largest share of India’s known gold reserves at 44-45%, followed by Rajasthan at 25% and Karnataka at 21%. West Bengal and Andhra Pradesh account for 3% each, while Jharkhand holds 2%. India’s gold imports fell 39.9% year-on-year to $24.78 billion during April-October 2026, compared with $41.24 billion in the corresponding period.
title: India, with 607 tonnes of gold resources, wants to mine more instead of importing

author: SHIVANGHI PAYAL
description: On Monday, China's stock markets experienced a downturn, primarily fueled by concerns over the sustainability of the recent AI-driven rally. Significant losses were recorded in technology shares, particularly within the 5G sector. Furthermore, troubling data concerning factory output and consumer expenditure cast doubts on the state of the nation's economy. Other Asian markets similarly faced declines, with investors closely watching for earnings updates from Nvidia and Anthropic later this week.
title: China stocks hover near July 2025 lows as AI jitters hit tech shares

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: A Manhattan landlord has filed a $550,000 lawsuit against a 72-year-old tenant accused of harassing three families who lived in the apartment above hers. The latest family, with three children, alleged repeated threats, abusive shouting and police calls. A judge has issued a temporary restraining order. The landlord also claims the tenant owes nearly $88,000 in rent.
title: NY family says neighbour threatened them and kept calling police; judge steps in

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: Intel shareholders have filed a lawsuit claiming the company concealed information about declining PC sales affecting revenue. They allege Intel raised significant funds shortly before the announcement of a sales decline. Intel's CEO expressed disappointment over manufacturing issues and a memory shortage impacting production. The company reported lower-than-expected earnings and a forecast for a continued decline in PC sales.
title: Upset shareholders sue Intel; claim it didn’t share 'disastrous' PC sales on time

author: AMIT KUMAR
description: Usman Khawaja disclosed that David Warner only learned about his writing on the ball-tampering scandal two months prior to publication. Khawaja had promised Warner in 2020 to address the controversy, and he finally informed him before the release. Warner expressed surprise upon receiving the chapter about the scandal just a week earlier. Khawaja's account has rekindled discussions surrounding the 2018 incident involving sandpaper.
title: Sandpapergate row: Khawaja reveals why he kept David Warner in the dark

author: ABHISHEK MISHRA
title: Terrorist killed in J&K's Kulgam encounter days after attack on CRPF personnel

author: AMIT KUMAR
description: Usman Khawaja shared details of his discussions with Steve Smith regarding his autobiography on the ball-tampering scandal. He waited until Smith's Test match was over before addressing his claims in the book. Khawaja expressed that he felt the need to stand up for players treated unfairly after the incident. Although he expected some criticism, he was surprised by the personal nature of some attacks.
title: Sandpapergate: Khawaja reveals 'awkward' conversation with Steve Smith

author: SMRITI JAIN
description: Jimmy is the younger son of Naval Tata and his first wife, Sooni Commissariat. His views have come to light as the Tata group faces an intensifying battle over control. The Tata Sons board and Noel Tata, who chairs Tata Trusts, the company’s majority shareholder, have been at loggerheads over several issues.
title: Ratan Tata’s brother, backs Chandrasekaran’s reappointment & Tata Sons listing

author: SHIVANGHI PAYAL
description: In October, wholesale inflation in India surged to 12.29%, up from 11.39% in September. This increase was largely driven by a dramatic rise in fuel and power prices, which skyrocketed to 32.84%. While crude petroleum and natural gas prices soared by 70.80%, primary food articles experienced only a slight inflation uptick. Meanwhile, manufactured goods showed minor easing, resulting in a cumulative WPI inflation of 10.14% from April to October.
title: Wholesale inflation jumps to 12.29% in October due to rising crude and power prices

author: BIJU MATHEW
description: Delhi's air quality index hit an alarming 363 on November 14, classified as very poor, with North Campus and Narela exceeding 400. This high pollution has resulted in a surge of respiratory problems in hospitals, notably among younger populations. Families now face tough decisions regarding their children's education and travel.
title: So what does a severe AQI day actually mean for a Delhi family’s daily routine?

author: JEHANGIR B GAI
description: Abhishek Dhanresha, owner of Mateshri Textiles, faced an insurance claim repudiation from United India Insurance after a factory fire. The insurer cited reasons including unauthorized construction and lack of fire-fighting appliances as grounds for denial. Despite these claims, the insurance company had previously inspected the premises without any objections noted. The Maharashtra State Commission found the insurer's refusal to settle the claim unjustifiable given their prior actions.
title: Maharashtra consumer panel orders insurer to pay Rs 87.33 lakh for fire claim

author: DHRUV YADAV
description: Indian Air Force will induct the Tejas Mk-1A fighter aircraft before the end of March this year. This induction will augment the IAF's capabilities and address decreasing fighter squadron numbers. Tejas Mk-1A features improved avionics and electronic warfare capabilities compared to earlier variants. The IAF has plans for the Tejas Mk-2 and the Advanced Medium Combat Aircraft in the future.
title: IAF's long wait for Tejas Mk-1A nears end: Why it matters

author: TOI SCIENCE DESK
title: Winnie the pig uses digging skills to fix leaking Scottish pond for wildlife

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: Recent research highlights that Manx shearwaters returning from foraging encounters navigational challenges akin to human jet lag. Prolonged flights disrupt their internal clocks, causing misalignment with the local time, which results in notable directional inaccuracies, particularly among novice birds. Analysis of two decades of GPS data from over 1,000 nesting shearwaters underscores these findings. Further investigation is required to assess how this temporal discrepancy may affect additional behaviors.
title: Fast Atlantic flights give seabirds 'jet lag', sending even adults off course

author: TOI SCIENCE DESK
description: After four centuries, the 16th-century brass lock from the Ann Francis shipwreck has finally been unlocked. Utilizing cutting-edge micro-CT scanning technology, researchers deciphered the combination as ANCE. This remarkable find is part of a treasure trove uncovered on Margam Beach in South Wales. Though the letters' meaning remains a mystery, the padlock is now proudly exhibited at the National Waterfront Museum, highlighting its importance in maritime history.
title: 443 years after a shipwreck, X-rays crack a smuggler's four-letter padlock code

author: VIVEK DUBEY
description: The BJP has lodged a complaint with the Foreigners Regional Registration Office (FRRO) in Hyderabad over alleged interference in India's internal affairs by foreign political representatives at the Congress-organised Bharat Summit 2026. Telangana BJP president N Ramchander Rao accused Italian politician Giacomo Filibeck of making provocative remarks in support of the Congress. Filibeck had criticised India's democratic situation and called for international support for Rahul Gandhi, drawing criticism from the BJP and Italian lawmakers.
title: BJP lodges complaint after Italian leader's 'vote chor' remark at Congress-led Summit

author: SAURABH THAKUR
description: In a recent ruling, an Andhra Pradesh consumer commission ordered Amazon and the seller to issue a refund. Kausari Khanum had ordered a Seiko wristwatch worth Rs 30,000 but received a black polythene roll instead. The commission held both parties accountable for failing to provide the correct item and not resolving the refund issue. Compensation of Rs 21,000 and litigation expenses of Rs 10,000 were also awarded.
title: Woman wins Rs 58k after receiving black polythene instead of Seiko watch she ordered

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: A handwritten property deed from 1902 became the center of a legal dispute over mineral rights. The Supreme Court of Appeals of West Virginia upheld an appellate ruling regarding the deed's interpretation. The case involved claims to ownership of oil and gas beneath a 117.55-acre property. The court concluded that the Severin family retained one-sixteenth of the oil and gas rights, not one-half.
title: 1902 deed: West Virginia heirs claim half of oil rights; court rules only 1/16

author: JYOTIRMOY HALDER
description: Sunil Gavaskar praised Mohit Ulva for his match-winning performance in India's U19 Asia Cup 2026 final against Pakistan, comparing his composure to MS Dhoni. Ulva smashed an unbeaten 49 off 26 balls, helping India chase 338 after slipping to 252/8. Gavaskar also compared his winning boundary and celebration to Dhoni's memorable 2011 World Cup final moment.
title: 'Iceman': Gavaskar compares Ulva to Dhoni after U19 Asia Cup final heroics

author: ABHISHEK MISHRA
title: Watch: AAP shares video of dead cow floating in UP canal during Chhath Puja

author: ABHISHEK MISHRA
description: Iran has publicly threatened two US navy officers it accused of directing a February 28 Tomahawk missile strike on an elementary school in Minab that killed 168 children. The Iranian Embassy in South Africa posted their photographs on X with the warning, "We will find you". The threat comes amid escalating tensions between Tehran and Washington over security threats.
title: 'We will find you': Iran's stern warning to US navy officers for Minab school strike

author: VIVEK DUBEY
title: 'Show some respect': SC pulls up Centre over shifting of 135-year-old Delhi library

author: VIVEK DUBEY
title: Bilkis Bano gangrape case: SC suspends life sentence of two convicts, grants bail

author: TRISHA MAHAJAN
description: India has officially joined the San Francisco Declaration, aimed at bolstering critical technologies worldwide. With a focus on enhancing AI supply chains amid escalating global tensions, particularly with China, this agreement has gathered support from nations including South Korea and the UAE. The US is also stepping up by providing financial backing for infrastructure and critical mineral recycling, highlighting a collaborative commitment to technology security across allied nations.
title: Did Nvidia row led to anti-China stance? US, India sign pact to protect AI supply chain

author: YASHASVI VASISTHA
description: India is closely monitoring China's military activities while enhancing its military capabilities through new technologies. Air Chief Marshal Ashutosh Dixit stated that the Indian Air Force will induct a squadron of LCA Mark 1A soon. The development of LCA Mark 2 and Advanced Medium Combat Aircraft continues to progress effectively. Peace and stability along the India-China border are essential for improving bilateral relations in the future.
title: India has plans to deter Chinese aggression, monitoring military activity: Air chief

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: Ishaan Surve initiated Praakruti, providing eco-friendly do-it-yourself toy kits sourced from natural materials. The project aims to reduce plastic usage while supporting tribal families through sustainable income sources. Praakruti has produced over 750 eco-friendly toy options and reached thousands of children with educational initiatives. Ishaan's efforts include interactive workshops and environmental awareness programs that have sensitized numerous villagers. This venture signifies the connection between creativity, environmental responsibility, and community welfare.
title: Ishaan Surve's eco-friendly toys support 56 tribal families, reach 40,000

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: After more than 100 years, scientists found young European flat oysters in Dornoch Firth, indicating successful natural breeding and conservation. The project aimed to restore native oyster populations through the introduction of adult oysters, totaling around 140,000, over 12 years. Restoration efforts have shown progress as oysters are now reproducing naturally in their habitat. The project supports marine biodiversity by enhancing ecosystems through oyster reef formation.
title: Scottish oysters reproduce in wild after 100 years, 140,000 restored

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: More than 28 cyclists participated in the eighth annual Turkey Ride to deliver Thanksgiving turkeys. They gathered at Maine Sport Rockport and picked up items from Hannaford Supermarkets. After collecting donations, they transported the groceries to the Camden Area Christian Food Pantry. Fifty-eight families benefited from the food pantry's effort, receiving turkeys for their Thanksgiving meals. The event highlighted community support for those in need and encouraged charitable involvement.
title: 28 Maine cyclists deliver Thanksgiving turkeys to 58 families

author: SAURABH THAKUR
description: In a landmark decision, a consumer commission in Haryana has ruled against an insurance provider for failing to settle a claim related to a stolen motorcycle. Despite law enforcement's efforts to locate the vehicle, it remained missing. The commission addressed the service deficiency and mandated the insurer to disburse the insured value along with compensation and legal expenses. Payment is expected within 45 days, subject to specified conditions.
title: Insurer withheld claim for stolen Splendor; consumer court awards Rs 61k to owner

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: At the age of 75, Jim Chew was ready for new adventures after retirement. With 31 state fairs already visited, he set a goal to explore all 50 by 2030. Each fair offers him a taste of local culture, foods, and a chance to connect with diverse communities. Jim's organized excursions aim to enrich his journey across the nation, filling his days with exciting experiences instead of monotony.
title: Ohio retiree, 78, visits 31 state fairs in quest to see all 50

title: Chai with Sachin & gully cricket: Prince William and Kate get royal welcome in Mumbai

author: SAURABH THAKUR
description: The Himachal Pradesh high court has directed the Central government and NHAI to pay interest to landowners. This decision follows a significant delay in compensating landowners for land acquired for a national highway project. The court ruling emphasized that interest should be paid due to the one-year delay in depositing the compensation amount. The amount to be paid is 7.5 percent annual interest for the delayed period.
title: Land acquired, compensation delayed: When must govt pay interest? HC answers

author: ABHISHEK MISHRA
description: BJP MP Manoj Tiwari performed Usha Arghya rituals in the Yamuna in Delhi with his wife, Surabhi Tiwari, as Chhath Puja celebrations concluded on Monday. Tiwari said festivities had spread across 15 km of the riverbank, crediting the BJP government for arrangements. BJP chief Nitin Nabin and former Union minister Dharmendra Pradhan also offered prayers to the rising Sun.
title: Watch: Manoj Tiwari offers Usha Arghya in Delhi's Yamuna; BJP leaders join Chhath celebrations

author: TOI SCIENCE DESK
title: Australian reptile park welcomes first king cobra hatchlings in 16 years

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Kevin Short found a centuries-old gold ring inscribed “I live in hope” just 15 minutes into a metal-detecting search in Warwickshire. Authenticated by the British Museum, the 16th-to-18th-century ring is expected to fetch up to £3,000 at a December 2 auction.
title: Man finds centuries-old gold ring in 15 minutes; could fetch £3,000

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Douglas Halley, a 103-year-old D-Day veteran, recently received his wartime medals which were lost in 1945. A young historian, Joseph Smith, discovered Halley's military record while researching veterans' stories and assisted in recovering the medals. The Ministry of Defence located and mailed the medals back to Halley just before Remembrance Day. This story highlights the importance of remembering personal histories and the sacrifices of war.
title: 103-year-old D-Day veteran gets wartime medals back after 80 years

author: YASHASVI VASISTHA
description: Banks are considering adopting artificial intelligence agents, expecting to recover investments within around ten months. Analysis suggests substantial returns of nearly three times the initial investment over three years. Increasing competition emphasizes the need for banks to move quickly beyond pilot projects for effective integration. However, productivity gains from AI do not guarantee improved profits for banks, indicating a gap in performance.
title: AI agents could help banks generate nearly 3x returns over three years: McKinsey

author: SHIVANGHI PAYAL
description: In 2025, low and middle-income countries are grappling with an alarming spike in external debt, hitting a staggering $9.4 trillion. Alongside this, debt repayment burdens surged to $1.4 trillion, largely due to escalating borrowing rates and a scarcity of new financial support. Nations receiving IDA funding are particularly strained, facing average interest rates of 8.2 percent.
title: Debt, dues and deja vu: How poor nations end up paying more than they borrow

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: At 102 years old, William Lyford received France's prestigious Legion of Honor, honoring his bravery during World War II, particularly his role in liberating Dachau concentration camp in 1945. The touching ceremony held in Woodstock was filled with family, friends, and fellow veterans celebrating his significant contributions. Despite his service, Lyford’s daughter shared how he rarely discussed his military past, showcasing the lasting bond between the U.S. and France.
title: WWII veteran who helped liberate Dachau gets France's highest honour at 102

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: Jensen Huang is considering a return as Nvidia CEO just days after resigning over extramarital affairs. A Huang ally is building a Silicon Valley ‘war room’ to lobby Nvidia’s board and seek White House support. Over 1.69 lakh people, including Elon Musk and over 8,000 Nvidia employees, have signed a ‘Bring Jensen Back’ letter, though US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent wants a ‘dramatic shake-up’.
title: Days after resigning, Jensen Huang ‘talks’ return as Nvidia CEO

author: TRISHA MAHAJAN
description: BJP condemned Congress party leader Devendra Yadav for allegedly polluting the Yamuna River during Chhath Puja. The BJP accused Congress of disrespecting the faith of Chhath devotees amidst environmental concerns. Cleaning efforts are underway as pollution in the Yamuna raises public health issues ahead of the festival. Authorities are preparing designated ghats for devotees while addressing river pollution.
title: 'Insult to faith': BJP shares video of Cong leader throwing plastic bottle in Yamuna

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: The reappointment reflects the Board's confidence in Jay Shah's leadership and ensures continuity at a crucial juncture for the sport, with global expansion, growing fan engagement and commercial development among the key priorities on the ICC's strategic roadmap.
title: Jay Shah reappointed unopposed as ICC chairman for second term

author: AMIT KUMAR
description: Bangladesh began their Test against South Africa with early setbacks, losing three wickets for just 22 runs. However, Towhid Hridoy and Litton Das rebuilt the innings through a historic partnership of 206 runs. Hridoy scored a century while Litton contributed an unbeaten 92, leading Bangladesh to their highest total against South Africa. After struggling at 121/5, their final score of 327/6 at stumps showcased their resilience.
title: History made! Bangladesh post record Test total against South Africa

author: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK
description: ‘Ramayana’ continues its record run, earning Rs 75 crore on its second Sunday (day 11) to post Bollywood’s biggest second Sunday, beating ‘Dhurandhar 2’. Released November 5, the Ranbir Kapoor, Sai Pallavi and Yash starrer has collected Rs 760.60 crore so far. Part two arrives Diwali 2028.
title: 'Ramayana' day 11: Film earns Rs 75cr, sets Bollywood record for biggest second Sunday

author: ABHISHEK MISHRA
title: Hundreds of protesters clash with police in Manila ahead of Trump's visit - video

author: TRISHA MAHAJAN
description: California's coastline recently faced towering waves that caused significant damage and led to the temporary closure of several renowned piers. With the National Weather Service alerting residents and tourists about dangerous rip currents, safety recommendations were put in place. Some beaches in Southern California saw seawater flooding, prompting evacuation advisories.
title: Watch: Massive waves lash California coastline, forces closure of several piers

author: YASHASVI VASISTHA
description: A political controversy has emerged in West Bengal over Chhath Puja preparations, led by TMC MP Kalyan Banerjee's statements. Banerjee alleged that the state was being dominated by non-Bengalis and accused the BJP government of neglecting Bengali culture. West Bengal minister Indranil Khan and Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari defended the arrangements for Chhath Puja and rejected claims of cultural appropriation.
title: ‘Does Bengal belong to Bengalis or rogue Biharis?’ TMC MP's remarks on Chhath spark row

author: AMIT KUMAR
description: Young batter Yashveer Goud revealed that emotional reactions followed India's U19 Asia Cup final victory over Pakistan. India had previously lost to Pakistan in the group stages during Diwali and wanted to avenge that loss. In the final, India successfully chased down Pakistan's score on the last ball, winning by one wicket. Goud noted that the team's celebration mirrored Pakistan's reactions after their earlier win.
title: 'Abusive language': What fuelled India's fierce celebrations against Pakistan

author: SOUMITTRA S BOSE
description: Varsha Turkar, a 35-year-old airline employee, was found stabbed in a secluded area of Gondia district. She had traveled to her maternal home to celebrate Diwali with her daughter and was scheduled to return to Pune. Her male companion, Nitesh Agrawal, reported an attack by unidentified robbers but his account raised suspicions. Agrawal was unharmed while Varsha suffered multiple stab wounds, leading to her death at the hospital.
title: Airline staffer found stabbed to death in MP forest; friend's story raises suspicion

title: Video: Massive blaze rips through resort in Thailand's Phuket; 11 killed

author: TNN
title: Ahead of Manila meet, US denies Quad faltering under Trump

author: NAOMI CANTON
description: IPL founder Lalit Modi, who left India in 2010 amid allegations of tax evasion, money laundering and proxy ownership linked to IPL, has announced he has received British citizenship. Lalit was appearing at an event at Oxford Union when he made the announcement.
title: 'No extradition request': Lalit Modi speaks to TOI after getting British citizenship

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: Research shows that an increase in salary can correlate with changes in personality traits over time. Higher income leads to an increase in conscientiousness and emotional stability, reflecting how individuals approach work. However, this increase may also be associated with a decrease in agreeableness and extraversion. The study involved a large sample of workers across five countries over several years.
title: Bigger pay may make you more diligent, slightly less agreeable

author: ABHISHEK MISHRA
description: Security forces defused three grenades found in a polythene bag in north Kashmir's Baramulla district, as news agency ANI reported Monday. The recovery comes days after police arrested a man and seized two hand grenades from a forest in Tangmarg. Police are investigating the source of the explosives, their intended use and possible links.
title: 3 grenades found in polythene bag defused in J&K's Baramulla

author: SAHIL MALHOTRA
description: In an exclusive conversation with TOI, Naman Dhir spoke about his rapid rise, the challenges of life in international cricket, his bowling transformation, and his dream of featuring in the 2027 ODI World Cup.
title: Exclusive | I want to win matches for India for a long time: Naman Dhir

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: Priscilla Chan's innovative primary school in East Palo Alto has officially closed after nearly ten years of operation. Funded by the Chan Zuckerberg Initiative, the school focused on integrating education with healthcare for low-income families. Although it served nearly 540 children, the academic performance fell short of expectations, leading to its closure. CZI has committed $50 million to support affected families during this transition.
title: Zuckerberg’s wife Priscilla Chan’s school shuts after 10 yrs, $125m in donations

author: TNN
description: During their much-anticipated visit to Mumbai, Prince William and Kate Middleton will engage in a series of exciting events, including a lively game of gully cricket with local youth led by cricket legend Sachin Tendulkar. They are set to attend the prestigious Earthshot Prize awards and meet with influential community leaders.
title: Mumbai rolls out the pitch for Prince William & Kate

author: YASHASVI VASISTHA
description: Deborah Bergamini has expressed discontent over Giacomo Filibeck's remarks on India’s electoral process. She emphasized that India has its own political institutions to handle such disputes. Filibeck’s comments occurred during the Bharat Summit 2026, where he supported the Indian Congress Party. The BJP responded by accusing the Congress of seeking foreign interference in national matters. This situation highlights ongoing tensions between Indian political factions regarding electoral integrity and foreign influence.
title: 'Inappropriate to lecture India': Meloni ally hits back at Italian leader's BJP remarks

author: ABHISHEK MISHRA
description: The Aam Aadmi Party (AAP) accused the BJP governments in Delhi and at the Centre of making false claims about cleaning the Yamuna as Purvanchali devotees celebrated Chhath Puja at its ghats. Citing toxic foam in the river, AAP targeted Chief Minister Rekha Gupta, while the BJP defended its clean-up efforts and hit back at the previous AAP government.
title: 'Not AI, this is Yamuna': AAP, BJP lock horns over Chhath celebrations in Delhi

author: SAMAD HOQUE
description: In a dramatic police encounter in Bima village, Nuh, two alleged cattle smugglers lost their lives, and another was severely injured. This incident unfolded after law enforcement acted on intelligence about illegal cattle trafficking and came under gunfire by the suspects. While the injured were rushed to Shaheed Hasan Khan Mewati Medical College, authorities later confirmed that two succumbed to their injuries.
title: Two ‘cattle smugglers’ killed in Nuh encounter, 2nd in a month

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: A woman from Georgia received a substantial $2.5 million settlement for severe neck injuries resulting from a car accident in 2023. The incident occurred when her vehicle was rear-ended while awaiting at a traffic light. Following the crash, she underwent significant medical interventions, including spinal surgery. Her legal team emphasized how these injuries drastically altered her quality of life, highlighting the profound consequences of personal injuries.
title: Atlanta woman wins $2.5m after rear-end crash led to spinal fusion

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: In a tense Under-19 Asia Cup final against Pakistan, Aaryavir Sehwag battled his nerves but showed remarkable resilience, helping India secure a thrilling one-wicket victory while chasing a daunting target of 337 runs. Despite suffering two blows from the ball during his innings, he garnered cheers from even the Pakistani fans, ultimately finishing the tournament as the top scorer with 361 runs.
title: 'I kept chanting Sita Ram': Aaryavir Sehwag on India’s last-ball win vs Pakistan

author: SHIVANGHI PAYAL
description: Oil prices are on a downward trend due to an anticipated surplus and a recovery in shipments through the Strait of Hormuz. The International Energy Agency has indicated that supply could outstrip demand in the upcoming quarter, altering market forecasts. However, the United States has tightened restrictions on oil transport between its ports, complicating shipping logistics, while high freight rates continue to challenge traders amidst these changes.
title: Oil prices fall as surplus fears return after nine-month dry spell in the market

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: Following the dismissal of CEO Jensen Huang, U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent advocates for a radical leadership shift at Nvidia. He is demanding Nvidia's board to clarify recent claims about chip exports to China. Stressing the importance of external legal guidance, Bessent points out a pervasive culture of noncompliance within the company.
title: Scott Bessent signals ‘dramatic shakeup’ at Nvidia after Lutnick chip remarks

author: HIJAM RAJU SINGH
description: India achieved a 3-1 ODI series victory against New Zealand, highlighted by strong bowling performances. The final match featured India's bowlers dismissing New Zealand for 187 runs while defending a total of 210. Gautam Gambhir praised the team's bowling depth after the win. Despite batting struggles, Shreyas Iyer acknowledged the players' resilience and commitment throughout the series.
title: ‘Bowlers win you series’: Gambhir’s message after India’s historic triumph

author: SHIVANGHI PAYAL
description: US airlines faced significant disruptions as more than 10,000 flights were canceled or delayed due to technical failures. The issues resulted from maintenance work on routers used by the Federal Aviation Administration, leading to widespread communication problems. Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy stated that the situation could normalize by Monday, highlighting ongoing challenges with aging technology.
title: 10,000+ flights hit by disruption as US air-traffic system remains crippled

author: ABHISHEK MISHRA
description: US President Donald Trump is set to travel to Asia on Monday aboard the aircraft gifted by Qatar, even as questions remain over its promised security upgrades. According to NBC News, the jet has received some maintenance and cosmetic improvements, but the larger overhaul remains unclear months after an Iran-related security scare forced Trump to fly home from Turkey on a secret military plane.
title: 'Perfectly safe' but not 'maxed out'? Trump takes Qatar jet to Asia

author: YASHASVI VASISTHA
description: Iran has expressed that it is ready for potential military action while discussing diplomatic avenues with the United States. Deputy foreign minister Kazem Gharibabadi indicated three possible scenarios: diplomatic talks, economic blockades, and military response. Tehran has set specific conditions, including ending the war and lifting economic sanctions for any agreement. The arrival of the USS Theodore Roosevelt in the Middle East adds to ongoing regional tensions.
title: 'Not Cuba or Venezuela': Iran warns it will not wait for US attack before responding

author: YASHASVI VASISTHA
description: Amazon's planned launch of 40 satellites for its Leo internet network failed after the Vulcan rocket malfunctioned. The Vulcan rocket, operated by United Launch Alliance, experienced an anomaly 10 minutes after liftoff. This failure poses a setback for Amazon's satellite internet plans, which aim to compete with Elon Musk's Starlink. Amazon has also invested in other launch options including Blue Origin's New Glenn rocket and Arianespace.
title: Amazon loses 40 Leo satellites as ULA's Vulcan rocket fails minutes after launch

author: PRANAV SHUKLA
description: During India's ODI series against New Zealand, Rohit Sharma faced uphill challenges, delivering a disappointing average of 7.50. With two ducks contributing to his low scores over four innings, his best effort registered at only 23 runs. Nonetheless, India clinched a 22-run victory in the last ODI, finishing the series 3-1.
title: Worst ever! Rohit Sharma ends New Zealand series with unwanted career record

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: Initially disinterested in chess, Divya Deshmukh found her passion with the encouragement of her family. She rapidly rose through the ranks, claiming the title of national champion and later earning global fame by winning the FIDE Women's World Cup. As India's 88th Grandmaster, her accomplishments, recognized with the Arjuna Award from President Droupadi Murmu in 2026, aim to motivate young girls to embrace chess and pursue their dreams.
title: She slept through chess at 5, now she's India's 88th Grandmaster

author: JYOTIRMOY HALDER
description: Faf du Plessis revealed how Virat Kohli backed him unconditionally during his three-year stint as RCB captain from 2022 to 2024, despite the pressure of succeeding the Indian star. The two developed a close friendship, but Kohli also introduced du Plessis to luxury watches, prompting him to joke that Kohli was the “most expensive relationship” of his life.
title: 'I should've never bought': Faf reveals why Kohli is his most expensive relationship

author: ABHISHEK MISHRA
title: PM Modi to attend Asean, East Asia summits in Manila; what's on agenda

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Dr. Andrea Sansonnet saved one-year-old Maddox from drowning at a swimming pool in Newnan, Georgia. Her quick actions included performing CPR until he was breathing again after being underwater for about 90 seconds. On their shared birthday, the Newnan Police Department honored Dr. Sansonnet for her lifesaving efforts during the emergency. Maddox’s mother expressed gratitude for the doctor’s presence when the incident occurred.
title: Doctor on picnic saves drowning toddler who now shares her birthday

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: In Charleston, South Carolina, the Emanuel Nine Memorial has been unveiled, marking over a decade since the heart-wrenching shooting. Families and community figures participated in the dedication ceremony, honoring those lost in the tragic event. The memorial features peaceful benches and a beautiful fountain, designed for contemplation and remembrance. Chris Singleton emphasized its personal importance in honoring his mother's legacy.
title: 11 years after Charleston shooting, $25M memorial opens for victims

author: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK
description: Ed Kelce supported Jason and Travis from their childhood sporting days to their NFL careers. He coached them, helped manage their busy schedules and made sacrifices alongside Donna. Even when his marriage faced difficulties, he continued putting his sons first. His support remained strong after their success, including when the brothers faced each other in Super Bowl LVII.
title: Ed Kelce backed sons’ sports dreams; sacrifices helped them reach NFL

author: TOI REAL ESTATE DESK
description: A mansion located at 301 Plantation Road in Palm Beach is currently listed for sale at $32 million. The property has a history of foreclosure proceedings after the seller defaulted on a $22 million mortgage. This brand-new estate features over 9,000 square feet, seven bedrooms, and luxurious amenities like a double infinity-edge pool. A total of 21 luxury deals were signed in Palm Beach County during a recent week.
title: Palm Beach mansion on $9m site under $32m deal amid foreclosure suit

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: A jury in Colorado awarded $65 million to the family of Megan Arneson, who was killed in 2022. Arneson died when a truck carrying an improperly loaded excavator struck an I-25 overpass. Her 10-year-old son, who was in the vehicle, witnessed the tragic incident. The truck driver and the company both bore responsibility for the accident in the court's findings.
title: Mother killed after taking son to water park; Colorado family wins $65m

author: RAJ SHEKHAR JHA
title: Pannun case: US govt seeks 24-year jail, Nikhil Gupta pleads for 12

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: A chlorine gas leak occurred at the Hotel Ling Bao in Germany due to a Microsoft outage. The incident happened when an automated safety system could not alert staff to the chemical malfunction. This malfunction resulted in excessive chlorine levels that caused 15 people to experience respiratory irritation. Emergency responders attended to the situation and transported four individuals to nearby hospitals.
title: Microsoft outage reportedly blocked hotel safety alert; 15 people injured

author: KANGKAN KALITA
description: Outfit Seeks Scrapping Of Siang Project, Release Of Protesters
title: After 400km march, anti-dam group reaches Itanagar, issues ultimatum
